content: {"summary": "Apple’s FY2022 revenue appears in 13 rows because the data includes separate entries for each fiscal period—annual (FY), Q1, Q2, and Q3—with some rows lacking a period_frame and others specifying a calendar frame (e.g., CY2020, CY2020Q4).
